name: Language Models at Work
strandNote: Optional for every role. Researchers who search documents, build features from text or build tools on language models.
description: Find the right documents, keep text from leaking the future, and build a tool-using agent you can test.

skills.llm-lookahead: Look-ahead from what a model knows

requires.why: Searches by cosine similarity between embeddings, as built there.
Recall at k extends precision and recall from the classification level.
A training cut-off is hidden look-ahead, found with the as-of rules taught there.
Text features leak like any feature: fit vocabularies and scalers inside each fold.
Reuses its n-gram overlap test to ask whether a model has seen a document.
Prompting a model and checking its output are taught there; a quick check helps.

lessonObjectives.l1-words-as-weights: Write TF-IDF weights for a small corpus and match scikit-learn.
lessonObjectives.l2-the-closest-document: Rank documents by cosine similarity to a query and explain what stop words do to it.
lessonObjectives.l3-search-by-meaning: Build a search over embeddings, with documents split into overlapping chunks.
lessonObjectives.l4-did-we-find-it: Code recall at k and mean reciprocal rank, and compare two retrievers on labelled queries.
lessonObjectives.l5-what-the-model-knows: Explain why a model's training cut-off is look-ahead, and find the clean test window.
lessonObjectives.l6-text-as-a-feature: Build a daily text feature stamped with when each document became known.
lessonObjectives.l7-leaks-in-text: Find leaks in a text pipeline: full-sample vocabularies, memorised names and late timestamps.
lessonObjectives.l8-an-honest-text-backtest: Design a text-signal backtest that survives a cut-off check and the number of models tried.
lessonObjectives.l9-tools-as-schemas: Write tool definitions as JSON schemas and validate arguments against them.
lessonObjectives.l10-reading-a-tool-call: Code a parser that validates a model's tool call and returns errors the model can act on.
lessonObjectives.l11-the-agent-loop: Build an agent loop with stop conditions and a step cap against a scripted model.
lessonObjectives.l12-judging-an-agent: Evaluate agent trajectories on planted tasks, and decide when a fixed workflow beats an agent.
